This document explains how to use Licensing GraphQL. It includes an introduction to the API, details of the available queries with example requests and responses, and the complete GraphQL schema for reference.

---

## 1) Introduction to Licensing GraphQL

**Licensing GraphQL** is a modern API interface designed to provide comprehensive access to Cisco Licensing data through a flexible and efficient query language. It enables users to retrieve detailed information about license usage, entitlements, summaries, device inventories, and smart accounts within Cisco License Central. This API is intended for developers and administrators who need to integrate licensing data into their applications or workflows, offering precise control over the data requested and returned.

The Licensing GraphQL API supports querying at various levels such as Smart Account and Virtual Account, allowing filtering and pagination to optimize data retrieval. It is part of Cisco’s initiative to modernize licensing management by providing a unified, scalable, and developer-friendly interface.

> **Disclaimer:** A basic understanding of how GraphQL queries are constructed and executed is required to use this API effectively. For an introduction to GraphQL, see the [GraphQL Tutorial Documentation](https://graphql.org/learn/).

---

## 2) Queries

The Licensing GraphQL API exposes **five main queries**. Each query serves a specific purpose related to licensing data management.

---

### Query 1: `getDeviceInventory`

Retrieves a view of all devices (serviceable or license deployment identifiers) associated with a Smart Account or Virtual Account.

_Note: The following attributes are only a subset of the full attributes available. Refer to [Section 3) GraphQL Schema](#3-graphql-schema) for the complete list._

#### Inputs:
    - input: DeviceInput! containing:
        - filterBy: DeviceFilterByInput (optional filters like deviceName, productNumber, serialNumber, etc.)
        - pagination: PaginationInput! (page number, page size, sort order)
        - smartAccount: SmartAccountInput! (Smart Account ID and optional Virtual Accounts)
#### Outputs:
    - DeviceOutput! containing:
        - code: Int
        - data: [Device] (with detailed device attributes e.g., deviceName, serialNumber, contractData, warrantyStatus)
        - messages: [Message] (for partial data and validation info)
        - pagination: PaginationOutput
        - requestId: String
        - status: String
        - timestamp: String
#### Example Request:

<details>
<summary>Show Example</summary>

```graphql
query {
    getDeviceInventory(
        input: {pagination: {page: 1, pageSize: 10}, smartAccount: {id: 12345}, filterBy: {deviceName: "Router1"}}
    ) {
        code
        requestId
        status
        timestamp
        pagination {
            page
            pageSize
            pageTotal
            totalCount
        }
        data {
            deviceName
            deviceUuid
            serialNumber
            productNumber
            warrantyStatus
            warrantyStartDate
            warrantyEndDate
        }
    }
}
```

</details>

---

### Query 2: `getLicenseEntitlement`

Retrieves inventory of all license entitlements at the feature level for a Smart Account or Virtual Account.

_Note: The following attributes are only a subset of the full attributes available. Refer to [Section 3) GraphQL Schema](#3-graphql-schema) for the complete list._

#### Inputs:
    - input: LicenseEntitlementInput! containing:
        - filterBy: LicenseEntitlementFilterByInput (optional filters like product, purchaseOrderNumber, subscriptionId)
        - pagination: PaginationInput!
        - smartAccount: SmartAccountInput!
#### Outputs:
    - LicenseEntitlementOutput! containing:
        - code: Int
        - data: [LicenseEntitlement] (with attributes like billingType, ciscoOrderNumber, entitledQuantity, product, subscriptionId)
        - messages: [Message] (for partial data and validation info)
        - pagination: PaginationOutput
        - requestId: String
        - status: String
        - timestamp: String
#### Example Request:

<details>
<summary>Show Example</summary>

```graphql
query {
    getLicenseEntitlement(
        input: {pagination: {page: 1, pageSize: 10}, smartAccount: {id: 12345}, filterBy: {ciscoOrderNumber: 45678910}}
    ) {
        code
        requestId
        status
        timestamp
        pagination {
            page
            pageSize
            pageTotal
            totalCount
        }
        data {
            product
            entitledQuantity
            billingType
            subscriptionId
        }
    }
}
```

</details>

---

### Query 3: `getLicenseSummary`

Provides a point-in-time summary view of a license feature at the Smart Account or Virtual Account level.

_Note: The following attributes are only a subset of the full attributes available. Refer to [Section 3) GraphQL Schema](#3-graphql-schema) for the complete list._

#### Inputs:
    - input: LicenseSummaryInput! containing:
        - filterBy: LicenseSummaryFilterByInput (optional filters like inventoryType, product)
        - pagination: PaginationInput!
        - smartAccount: SmartAccountInput!
#### Outputs:
    - LicenseSummaryResponse! containing:
        - code: Int
        - data: [LicenseSummary] (with attributes such as entitledQuantity, inUseQuantity, balanceQuantity, feature details)
        - messages: [Message] (for partial data and validation info)
        - pagination: PaginationOutput
        - requestId: String
        - status: String
        - timestamp: String        
#### Example Request:

<details>
<summary>Show Example</summary>

```graphql
query {
    getLicenseSummary(
        input: {pagination: {page: 1, pageSize: 10}, smartAccount: {id: 12345}, filterBy: {inventoryType: UNASSIGNED}}
    ) {
        code
        status
        timestamp
        requestId
        pagination {
            page
            pageSize
            pageTotal
            totalCount
        }
        data {
            feature {
                displayName
                product
            }
            entitledQuantity
            balanceQuantity
            inUseQuantity
            reservedQuantity
        }
    }
}
```

</details>

---

### Query 4: `getLicenseUsage`

Retrieves all active consumption events at the feature level, regardless of source, for a Smart Account or Virtual Account.

_Note: The following attributes are only a subset of the full attributes available. Refer to [Section 3) GraphQL Schema](#3-graphql-schema) for the complete list._

#### Inputs:
    - input: LicenseUsageInput! containing:
        - filterBy: LicenseUsageFilterByInput (optional filters like parentId, product, subscriptionId)
        - pagination: PaginationInput!
        - smartAccount: SmartAccountInput!
#### Outputs:
    - LicenseUsageResponse! containing:
        - code: Int
        - data: [LicenseUsage] (with details such as consumptionId, consumptionQuantity, deviceIdentifiers, product, licenseSku)
        - messages: [Message] (for partial data and validation info)
        - pagination: PaginationOutput
        - requestId: String
        - status: String
        - timestamp: String
#### Example Request:

<details>
<summary>Show Example</summary>

```graphql
query MyQuery {
    getLicenseUsage(
        input: {
            pagination: {page: 1, pageSize: 10}, smartAccount: {id: 12345}, filterBy: {inventoryType: ASSIGNED}}
    ) {
        data {
            authorizedQuantity
            consumptionId
            consumptionQuantity
            deviceSourceRefId
            eventType
            product
            licenseSku
            skuQuantity
            smartAccount {
                id
            }
        }
    }
}
```

</details>

---

### Query 5: `getSmartAccount`

Retrieves information about Smart Accounts and their associated Virtual Accounts.

_Note: The following attributes are only a subset of the full attributes available. Refer to [Section 3) GraphQL Schema](#3-graphql-schema) for the complete list._

#### Inputs:
    - input: SmartAccountInput! containing:
      - pagination: PaginationInput!
      - smartAccount: SmartAccountInput!
#### Outputs:
    - SmartAccountResponse! containing:
      - code: Int
      - data: [SmartAccount]! (with details such as id, name, domain, type, virtualAccounts)
      - messages: [Message] (for partial data and validation info)
      - pagination: PaginationOutput
      - requestId: String
      - status: String
      - timestamp: String
#### Example Request:

<details>
<summary>Show Example</summary>

```graphql
query {
    getSmartAccount(
        input: {pagination: {page: 10, pageSize: 10}, smartAccount: {id: 12345}}
    ) {
        code
        pagination {
            page
            pageSize
            pageTotal
            totalCount
        }
        requestId
        status
        timestamp
    }
    data {
        id
        name
        virtualAccounts {
            id
            name
        }
    }
}
```

</details>

---

## 3) GraphQL Schema

This section provides the full GraphQL schema used for licensing operations. The schema defines all available queries and their input/output types, including every attribute for each query.     getSmartAccount(input: SmartAccountInput!): SmartAccountOutput!
}
